title: Rebuild and redeploy the existing app

requirements.text: Trigger a clean rebuild and redeploy of the current Foam Daddy Storefront application without introducing feature changes.
acceptanceCriteria: A fresh build completes successfully for both frontend and backend (no TypeScript or Motoko compilation errors).
The redeployed app loads successfully on the production URL and renders the landing page without requiring authentication.
Public routes remain accessible without authentication: `/`, `/products`, `/product/:id`, `/cart`, `/checkout`, `/request-quote`.
Admin routes remain gated behind Internet Identity authentication and admin role checks: `/admin/*`.

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend immutable paths (frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui).
Do not introduce any new user-facing features or UI changes unless required to fix a build-breaking issue discovered during rebuild.
nonGoals: Adding new pages, flows, or backend methods.
Changing styling, theme, or copy as part of the rebuild.
Data migrations or state schema changes unless strictly required to resolve a deployment failure.
